source: If you want me to be even more honest, I think the staff concerns are what troubles me the most.
translation: 如果要我更坦白一点，我认为员工方面的问题最令我担忧。

source: As you may have noticed from our meeting earlier, your fellow scoutmasters aren’t as ‘mature’ when it comes to their shortcomings in managing their departments.
translation: 从刚才的会议中你可能已经注意到，你的教官同事面对自己管理部门的缺点时，并没有那么“成熟”。

source: Are you talking about Aiden?
translation: 你说的是Aiden吗？

source: Who else would I be talking about?
translation: 不然我还能说谁？

source: It’s not normal for the leadership to engage in behavior like he does. And frankly, it makes the whole camp look bad.
translation: 领导层做出他那样的行为并不正常。坦白说，这会让整个营地显得很糟糕。

source: I… don’t think Aiden’s personal habits ever caused us trouble before. Are you sure you’re just not looking too much into it?
translation: 我……不认为Aiden的个人习惯以前给我们带来过麻烦。你确定不是想得太严重了吗？

source: Do you really want to wait until it becomes a problem? It’s better to deal with it now.
translation: 你真的想等它变成问题再处理吗？现在解决更好。

source: Even putting aside his habits, he has no management skills whatsoever.
translation: 即使先不谈他的习惯，他也完全没有管理能力。

source: It makes no sense why he has the same position as you given that he doesn’t meet the qualifications.
translation: 既然他不具备资质，却和你担任同样的职位，这完全说不通。

source: That will hinder this project in many ways we do not want to see.
translation: 这会以许多我们不愿看到的方式妨碍项目。

source: Eugh. Don’t give me that look, Yoshinori. It’s just business.
translation: 呃。别那样看我，Yoshinori。这只是公事。

source: Look, I know criticism isn’t easy to take in, but someone has to point these things out.
translation: 听着，我知道批评不容易接受，但总得有人指出这些问题。

source: You know me- I prefer to be straightforward, especially when it comes to work.
translation: 你了解我——我喜欢直截了当，尤其涉及工作时。

source: I… understand.
translation: 我……明白。

source: That doesn’t sound too enthusiastic. Did my comment about your role upset you?
translation: 听起来不太热情。是我对你职务的评论让你不高兴了吗？

source: You must be so tired of having no consistent responsibility for this project…
translation: 你一定已经厌倦了在项目中没有固定职责……

source: But don’t worry, I’m here to help!~
translation: 不过别担心，我来帮你了～！

source: Starting tomorrow, you and I will be in charge of both managing the construction as well as handling all staff concerns.
translation: 从明天开始，你和我会共同负责施工管理，并处理所有员工问题。

source: Are you saying we’ll take over both Aiden and Yuri’s tasks?
translation: 你是说我们要接管Aiden和Yuri的任务？

source: They’ll still be working in these departments, but you will be the one responsible for ensuring satisfactory results.
translation: 他们仍会在这些部门工作，但确保结果令人满意的人会是你。

source: Anyway, I’ll make sure that you know exactly what to do in both of these fields from now on.
translation: 总之，从现在起我会确保你清楚知道这两个领域该做什么。

source: Since I’ll be staying here for the QA work, I thought I’d go out of my way to make sure you get a clearer perspective!
translation: 既然我要留下负责质量保证工作，我想不妨额外帮你建立更清晰的认识！

source: There’s nobody better suited for the task, since it’s my job to oversee the entire project! We can take charge and lead together.
translation: 没有人比我更适合，因为我的职责就是监督整个项目！我们可以一起掌控并领导一切。

source: So? What do you say? Partners?
translation: 怎么样？你怎么说？成为搭档？

source: I… I’m not sure about this, Emilia…
translation: 我……我不确定这样好不好，Emilia……

source: Why, that’s not the right answer!
translation: 哎呀，这可不是正确答案！

source: You should be grateful; I’m offering to fix the exact issue you just mentioned.
translation: 你应该感激，我正主动帮你解决刚刚提到的问题。

source: It baffles me why you’re having second thoughts about this. Help is literally being served to you on a silver—no, gold platter!
translation: 真不明白你为什么还会犹豫。帮助都已经装在银盘——不，是金盘里送到面前了！

source: I-It’s not that I don’t appreciate your offer, but I was trying to make a plan to resolve it myself…
translation: 不、不是我不感激你的提议，但我原本正打算自己制定计划解决……

source: And that plan is…?
translation: 那个计划是……？

source: W-Well… I haven’t completely figured it out yet.
translation: 这、这个……我还没有完全想好。

source: Can you at least give me a little time to think about what you’re proposing? It’s all very sudden, after all…
translation: 至少能给我一点时间考虑你的提议吗？毕竟这一切太突然了……

source: Fine. I’ll give you until tomorrow morning to decide.
translation: 好吧。我给你到明天早上作决定。

source: Let me emphasize this one last time though, since you seem to not be getting it.
translation: 不过你似乎还没明白，让我最后再强调一次。

source: I’m a professional with exactly the experience you need, and I’m going out of my way to help you. The right choice is obvious.
translation: 我是专业人士，拥有你正需要的经验，而且特意主动帮助你。正确选择显而易见。

source: You need some guidance, and we can catch up! I don’t see any loss here.
translation: 你需要一些指导，我们也能趁机叙旧！我看不出有什么损失。

source: I’ll keep that in mind, Emilia…
translation: 我会记住的，Emilia……

source: Excellent~! I expect nothing but great things from you, Yoshinori! It’s a pleasure to work with you again!
translation: 太好了～！我只期待你做出卓越成绩，Yoshinori！很高兴再次与你共事！

source: Everything will be alright now that I’m here!
translation: 既然我来了，一切都会好起来！

source: Now, all this serious business has made me tired, not to mention all the walking around the camp to inspect!
translation: 好了，这些严肃的公事让我累坏了，更别提为了检查还绕着营地走了那么多路！

source: I’ll take my leave for now and rest up! I still have to send an email report to Mr. Clermont, after all!
translation: 我先告辞休息了！毕竟还得通过邮件向Clermont先生发送报告！

source: R-Right. Goodnight, Emilia.
translation: 好、好的。晚安，Emilia。

source: Toodles~
translation: 回头见～

source: Alright, Gramps! That should be all your stuff!
translation: 好了，Gramps！你的东西应该都搬完了！

source: Thanks for helping me move in.
translation: 谢谢你帮我搬进来。

source: Don’t mention it!
translation: 别客气！

source: I hope it won’t be a hassle for you to stay here with us, Sir Goro…
translation: 希望和我们住在这里不会给您添麻烦，Goro先生……

source: It’s no problem. I don’t mind having some extra company.
translation: 没问题。我不介意多几个人陪伴。

source: Haha, looks like you got demoted, huh Gramps?
translation: 哈哈，看来你被降职了，对吧，Gramps？

source: Careful what you say, Aiden. Sir Goro’s still in charge! You could get fired with one snap!
translation: 说话小心点，Aiden。Goro先生仍然负责这里！他打个响指就能开除你！

source: I know, I know, I’m just kidding around. Everyone hasn’t cracked a smile since that meeting.
translation: 知道，知道，我只是开玩笑。那场会议后大家连一次笑容都没露过。

source: Looks like Ms. Emilia really said some upsetting things back there, huh?
translation: 看来Emilia女士刚才说了不少让人难受的话，对吧？

source: The criticisms were rather trifling, but we don’t have much of a choice except to try and make do since Mr. Clermont placed her here.
translation: 那些批评相当琐碎，但既然Clermont先生把她安排在这里，我们也只能尽量适应。

source: Yeah… And Yuri didn’t take it so well… I’ve never seen her lose her temper like that!
translation: 是啊……Yuri也没能很好地接受……我从没见过她发那么大脾气！

source: On the upside, I think we’re all destined to connect better thanks to the divination I did earlier while you guys were in that meeting!
translation: 往好处想，根据你们开会时我做的占卜，我们注定会建立更紧密的联系！

source: I interpreted my reading as “New Beginnings,” and that’s already true from the changes happening so far!
translation: 我把占卜结果解读为“新的开始”，从目前发生的变化来看已经应验了！

source: I still have no clue what you’re trying to say…
translation: 我还是完全不懂你想说什么……

source: He means it’s good luck.
translation: 他的意思是这是好运。

source: Whatever mumbo jumbo Lloyd is saying, I agree!
translation: 不管Lloyd说的是什么神神叨叨的话，我都同意！

source: Let’s look on the bright side, especially since we’ll be way busier starting tomorrow!
translation: 我们往好处看吧，尤其明天开始会忙得多！

source: That’s a very good mindset to have, Aiden.
translation: 这种心态很好，Aiden。

source: Yeah, I bet the only time we’ll have to casually chat with each other will be at night after work, like this!
translation: 是啊，我敢说以后能像这样随意聊天的时间，只剩下晚上工作结束后了！

source: With that being said, we should all try and get up earlier than usual
translation: 话虽如此，我们都应该尽量比平时更早起床。

source: Let’s not give our new inspector any reason to think we’re not taking this sponsorship seriously.
translation: 别给新检查员任何理由，让她觉得我们没有认真对待这项赞助。

source: Uh-oh, it’s bedtime already and Gramps is getting cranky~.
translation: 哦豁，已经到睡觉时间，Gramps开始发脾气了～

source: *sigh* Aiden…
translation: *叹气* Aiden……

source: You can take my bunk, sir! I’m sharing a bed with Dar!
translation: 您可以睡我的床，先生！我和Dar共用一张！

source: Are you sure that’s alright with you two?
translation: 你确定你们两个都没问题吗？

source: It’s fine. He won’t take up much space.
translation: 没问题。他占不了多少地方。

source: Hey! Not you too, Dar!
translation: 喂！连你也这么说，Dar！

source: You guys go ahead. I’m gonna take a shower since I’m just about to start my day.
translation: 你们先睡吧。我正要开始今天，所以去洗个澡。

source: Alright. Good night, then.
translation: 好。那么晚安。

source: Night.
translation: 晚安。

source: So, you wanna tell me why you’re spacing out again, Yoshi?
translation: 那么，愿意告诉我你为什么又在发呆吗，Yoshi？

source: Don’t tell me Emilia got under your skin too?!
translation: 别告诉我Emilia也让你心烦了？！

source: Not exactly, but she did give me something to think about earlier.
translation: 不完全是，不过她之前确实给了我一些需要考虑的事。

source: She didn’t have a problem with you, did she?
translation: 她不是对你有意见吧？

source: Quite the opposite, actually…
translation: 事实上，正好相反……

source: She told me that she wanted to work with me to help clear up my role on this project.
translation: 她说想和我一起工作，帮我明确在项目中的职责。

source: You know… the same thing I’ve been thinking about for the past week…
translation: 你知道……就是过去一周我一直思考的那件事……

source: Did you… accept her offer?
translation: 你……接受她的提议了吗？

source: I didn’t give her an answer just yet…
translation: 我还没有给她答案……

source: If I’m being honest, you’re probably the only one who can get along with her when it comes to work…
translation: 老实说，工作方面大概只有你能和她相处融洽……

source: I know… And I think she genuinely wants to help me out too, but that evaluation a while ago really seemed unnecessarily harsh.
translation: 我知道……而且我觉得她是真心想帮我，但刚才那场评估似乎严厉得没有必要。

source: Yeah, tell me about it. She really put me in the spotlight back there and called me out in front of you guys.
translation: 是啊，可不是嘛。她刚才把我推到风口浪尖，当着你们的面点名批评。

source: If that meeting had lasted any longer, I bet she’d really have started digging into me.
translation: 那场会议要是再久一点，我敢说她真会开始把我彻底扒个底朝天。

source: With an inspector keeping an eye on us all the time, I’m worried I might just cause trouble for everyone…
translation: 有检查员时刻盯着我们，我担心自己会给大家惹麻烦……

source: That’s what got me thinking, Aiden. It seems like she was making a huge deal out of your department and using that as a way to take over.
translation: 这正是让我思考的地方，Aiden。她似乎故意把你的部门说成严重问题，以此接管工作。

source: She’s also expecting me to work with her at the same time…
translation: 同时，她还期待我与她合作……

source: Well, this is Emilia we’re talking about, Yoshi. Everyone knows how she was in the past.
translation: 我们说的可是Emilia，Yoshi。大家都知道她过去是什么样。

source: That, and I think she just doesn’t like me for some reason. It’s just so different from how she acts around you.
translation: 而且不知为何，我觉得她就是不喜欢我。她在你面前的态度完全不同。

source: You’re right. I did notice that.
translation: 你说得对。我确实注意到了。

source: And that’s where I come in, Aiden.
translation: 所以这就轮到我出场了，Aiden。

source: I figured that if we focused on the same departments, then we can guarantee that Emilia won’t have anything to call us out for!
translation: 我想，只要我们共同专注于这些部门，就能确保Emilia找不到任何批评我们的理由！

source: Oh, we’re gonna work together? Now I can’t say no to that!
translation: 哦，我们要一起工作？那我可没法拒绝！

source: Not gonna lie, I was about to ask you for help after that nightmare feedback I got, so I’m really glad you ended up asking me!
translation: 不瞒你说，收到那场噩梦般的反馈后，我正打算找你帮忙，所以你主动提出真让我高兴！

source: Well, I’m really looking forward to it! I finally made up my mind about what my role in this project really is!
translation: 我真的很期待！终于决定好自己在这个项目中真正的职责了！

source: What about Emilia though? She’s gonna be bummed if she finds out you’re turning her offer down.
translation: 不过Emilia怎么办？发现你拒绝她的提议，她会很失望吧。

source: I’m sure I can find a way to tell her as professionally as possible. What’s more important to me right now is taking the opportunity to help you.
translation: 我相信自己能以尽可能专业的方式告诉她。现在对我更重要的是抓住机会帮助你。

source: Aww, Yoshi~
translation: 啊，Yoshi～

source: You might have to start putting on more clothes, though. We can’t have her inspecting your butt too.
translation: 不过你可能得开始多穿点衣服。不能让她连你的屁股也检查。

source: Hahaha! Yeah, ‘cause that’s your job, right?
translation: 哈哈哈！对，因为那是你的工作，对吧？

source: Haha! That’s right!
translation: 哈哈！没错！

source: But in all seriousness, I’ll try to act more pro too. I’d really hate it if I dragged everyone down just because of my habits…
translation: 不过说正经的，我也会尽量表现得更专业。要是因为自己的习惯拖累大家，我真的会很难受……

source: Take it easy, Aiden. I’d really rather you be yourself.
translation: 放轻松，Aiden。我其实更希望你做自己。

source: And like I said, I’ll be staying by your side throughout this whole thing!
translation: 而且就像我说的，整个过程中我都会陪在你身边！

source: Oh, look at you~ You’re acting all positive again, just like when you were a scout!
translation: 哦，看看你～又变得这么积极，就像当童子军时一样！

source: Ahehe… You’re the one bringing it out for me.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……是你让我找回了这种感觉。

source: But really, thanks a lot, Yoshi. I feel better already.
translation: 不过说真的，非常谢谢你，Yoshi。我已经感觉好多了。

source: Of course! Now come on, let’s get to sleep – we have a busy day tomorrow!
translation: 当然！好了，快睡吧——明天会很忙！

source: Sure thing! Goodnight, Yoshi!
translation: 没问题！晚安，Yoshi！
